user_query: create me a SQL query to find the top 10 best-selling products in the last 3 years, including their category and subcategory, total quantity sold, total revenue generated, average selling price, number of distinct customers who bought them, and the best sales territory for each product. Use the saleslt schema.
generated_sql:
SELECT TOP 10 pc.Name AS Category, ps.Name AS Subcategory, p.Name AS Product, SUM(sod.OrderQty) AS TotalQuantitySold, SUM(sod.LineTotal) AS TotalRevenueGenerated, p.ListPrice AS AverageSellingPrice, COUNT(DISTINCT soh.CustomerID) AS NumberOfDistinctCustomers, st.Name AS BestSalesTerritory
FROM saleslt.SalesOrderDetail sod
JOIN saleslt.Product p ON sod.ProductID = p.ProductID
JOIN saleslt.ProductCategory pc ON p.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID
JOIN saleslt.ProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = ps.ProductSubcategoryID
JOIN saleslt.SalesOrderHeader soh ON sod.SalesOrderID = soh.SalesOrderID
JOIN saleslt.SalesTerritory st ON soh.TerritoryID = st.TerritoryID
WHERE soh.OrderDate >= DATEADD(year, -3, GETDATE())
GROUP BY pc.Name, ps.Name, p.Name, p.ListPrice, st.Name
ORDER BY TotalQuantitySold DESC
reasoning: The query was constructed by joining the necessary tables to gather information about product sales. The SalesOrderDetail table provides details on each product sold, while the Product, ProductCategory, and ProductSubcategory tables provide product information. The SalesOrderHeader table provides customer and order information, and the SalesTerritory table provides territory information. The query filters orders to only include those from the last 3 years and groups results by product category, subcategory, product name, and territory. The results are sorted in descending order by total quantity sold.


FROM saleslt.SalesOrderDetail sod
JOIN saleslt.Product p ON sod.ProductID = p.ProductID
JOIN saleslt.ProductCategory pc ON p.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID
JOIN saleslt.ProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = ps.ProductSubcategoryID
JOIN saleslt.SalesOrderHeader soh ON sod.SalesOrderID = soh.SalesOrderID
JOIN saleslt.SalesTerritory st ON soh.TerritoryID = st.TerritoryID
WHERE soh.OrderDate >= DATEADD(year, -3, GETDATE())
GROUP BY pc.Name, ps.Name, p.Name, p.ListPrice, st.Name
ORDER BY TotalQuantitySold DESC

source_queries: create me a SQL query to find the top 10 best-selling products in the last 3 years, including their category and subcategory, total quantity sold, total revenue generated, average selling price, number of distinct customers who bought them, and the best sales territory for each product. final_state.generated_sql:
SELECT TOP 10 pc.Name AS Category, ps.Name AS Subcategory, p.Name AS Product, SUM(sod.OrderQty) AS TotalQuantitySold, SUM(sod.LineTotal) AS TotalRevenueGenerated, p.ListPrice AS AverageSellingPrice, COUNT(DISTINCT soh.CustomerID) AS NumberOfDistinctCustomers, st.Name AS BestSalesTerritory
FROM saleslt.SalesOrderDetail sod
JOIN saleslt.Product p ON sod.ProductID = p.ProductID
JOIN saleslt.ProductCategory pc ON p.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID
JOIN saleslt.ProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = ps.ProductSubcategoryID
JOIN saleslt.SalesOrderHeader soh ON sod.SalesOrderID = soh.SalesOrderID
JOIN saleslt.SalesTerritory st ON soh.TerritoryID = st.TerritoryID
WHERE soh.OrderDate >= DATEADD(year, -3, GETDATE())
GROUP BY pc.Name, ps.Name, p.Name, p.ListPrice, st.Name
ORDER BY TotalQuantitySold DESC

final_state.generated_sql:
SELECT TOP 10 saleslt.Product.ProductID, saleslt.Product.Name, saleslt.ProductCategory.Name AS CategoryName, saleslt.ProductModel.Name AS ModelName, SUM(saleslt.SalesOrderDetail.OrderQty) AS TotalQuantitySold, SUM(saleslt.SalesOrderDetail.LineTotal) AS TotalRevenueGenerated, saleslt.Product.ListPrice AS AverageSellingPrice, COUNT(DISTINCT saleslt.SalesOrderHeader.CustomerID) AS DistinctCustomers, saleslt.SalesTerritory.Name AS BestSalesTerritory
FROM saleslt.Product
JOIN saleslt.ProductCategory ON saleslt.Product.ProductCategoryID = saleslt.ProductCategory.ProductCategoryID
JOIN saleslt.ProductModel ON saleslt.Product.ProductModelID = saleslt.ProductModel.ProductModelID
JOIN saleslt.SalesOrderDetail ON saleslt.Product.ProductID = saleslt.SalesOrderDetail.ProductID
JOIN saleslt.SalesOrderHeader ON saleslt.SalesOrderDetail.SalesOrderID = saleslt.SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID
JOIN saleslt.SalesTerritory ON saleslt.SalesOrderHeader.TerritoryID = saleslt.SalesTerritory.TerritoryID
WHERE saleslt.SalesOrderHeader.OrderDate >= DATEADD(year, -3, GETDATE())
GROUP BY saleslt.Product.ProductID, saleslt.Product.Name, saleslt.ProductCategory.Name, saleslt.ProductModel.Name, saleslt.Product.ListPrice, saleslt.SalesTerritory.Name
ORDER BY TotalRevenueGenerated DESC

SELECT TOP 10 pc.Name AS Category, pm.Name AS SubCategory, p.Name AS Product, 
                   SUM(sod.OrderQty) AS TotalQuantitySold, 
                   SUM(sod.LineTotal) AS TotalRevenueGenerated, 
                   SUM(sod.LineTotal) / NULLIF(SUM(sod.OrderQty), 0) AS AverageSellingPrice, 
                   COUNT(DISTINCT soh.CustomerID) AS NumberOfDistinctCustomers,
                   soh.ShipMethod
                   FROM SalesLT.SalesOrderDetail sod
                   JOIN SalesLT.Product p ON sod.ProductID = p.ProductID
                   JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory pc ON p.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID
                   JOIN SalesLT.ProductModel pm ON p.ProductModelID = pm.ProductModelID
                   JOIN SalesLT.SalesOrderHeader soh ON sod.SalesOrderID = soh.SalesOrderID
                   WHERE soh.OrderDate >= DATEADD(year, -3, GETDATE())
                   GROUP BY pc.Name, pm.Name, p.Name, soh.ShipMethod
                   ORDER BY TotalRevenueGenerated DESC

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

View: SalesLT.vProductAndDescription
Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)
  - Culture (NCHAR)
  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

View: SalesLT.vProductAndDescription
Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)
  - Culture (NCHAR)
  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

View: SalesLT.vProductAndDescription
Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)
  - Culture (NCHAR)
  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)
  - Culture (NCHAR)
  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)

  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

View: SalesLT.vProductAndDescription
Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)
  - Culture (NCHAR)
  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)
  - Culture (NCHAR)
  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)

  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

View: SalesLT.vProductAndDescription
Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)
  - Culture (NCHAR)
  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)
  - Culture (NCHAR)
  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)

  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

View: SalesLT.vProductAndDescription
Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)
  - Culture (NCHAR)
  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)
  - Culture (NCHAR)
  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

View: SalesLT.vProductAndDescription
Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)
  - Culture (NCHAR)
  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)
  - Culture (NCHAR)
  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];
