Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)

  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.

    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name]

    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p

    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)
  - Culture (NCHAR)
  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

View: SalesLT.vProductAndDescription
Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)
  - Culture (NCHAR)
  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.

    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p

    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING

-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.

    ,p.[Name]

FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p

    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.

    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p

    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)
  - Culture (NCHAR)
  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)
  - Culture (NCHAR)
  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.

  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)

  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

View: SalesLT.vProductAndDescription
Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)
  - Culture (NCHAR)
  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS

	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

)

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]
